verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a prebuilt n8n, Zapier, Make or other no-code automation connector for ScrapingBee. The only integration-adjacent surfaces documented are an MCP server, a CLI and a Postman collection. Those are different integration paths and give no credit toward a no-code platform connector.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
